comparison.objective: Lay a cable straight and secure it with staple blocks at prescribed spacings; candidate finishes HELICOILs.
comparison.physical_skill: Deformable cable positioning and repeated staple placement versus mandrel insertion, impact regulation, withdrawal, and fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Staples within 6 cm of both ends and no more than 20 cm apart, with cable in each slot, versus four contact-driven fractures and zero damage or fragment loss.
comparison.reason: Shared repeated placement is generic; the mechanisms and evaluated outcomes differ materially.
